page.overview:
Who is Tesan?

Tesan is an Aes Sedai of the White Ajah. She is an arithmetist who applies numbers to logic.

She has the typical beaded braids of a Taraboner. Her hair is dark and she has a narrow face.

She has remained loyal to the White Tower during the Schism.

In the White Tower, Alviarin Freidhen hears her discussing statistical methods relating to the failing of the Keepings on the food storerooms in the Tower with Astrelle.
